name: Original Oratory
prompts: Was the speech easy to follow?
Did examples back up the points?

tags.label: Thesis
tags.strength: Your main point was clear from the start.
tags.toWork: Make your main point clear in one sentence early on.

tags.label: Structure
tags.strength: Your speech was easy to follow from point to point.
tags.toWork: Make each part of the speech easier to follow, with clear steps.

tags.label: Evidence
tags.strength: Your examples and facts backed up your points well.
tags.toWork: Add stronger examples or facts to back up your points.

tags.label: Appeal
tags.strength: You made me care about this topic.
tags.toWork: Help the audience see why this topic matters to them.

tags.label: Delivery
tags.strength: Your voice and pace were easy to listen to.
tags.toWork: Vary your voice and pace so key lines stand out.

source: NSDA High School Unified Manual v2027.1.2, 2026-27 season. Summarized in our own words; no rule text copied.
